project.name: West Coast Hip-Hop Mainstream Dark Hook-Heavy Arrangement

arrangement.notes: Arrangement focused on dark mood with hook-heavy energy profile emphasizing mainstream West Coast Hip-Hop style using sample chops techniques for vocal and instrumental layers.

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Begin hook with increased vocal chops and energy

event_markers.label: Final Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Final hook with maximum vocal chop and hook energy

event_markers.label: Bridge FX
event_markers.reason: FX layer to highlight bridge section

track_roles.drums: Rhythmic drive with chopped percussive layers
track_roles.bass: Deep bass to support the groove
track_roles.chords: Harmonic foundation with chopped sample layers
track_roles.melody: Sparse melodic elements using micro and phrase chops
track_roles.vocal: Hook-heavy vocal chops including reverse and stutter chops
track_roles.fx: Atmospheric and transitional effects using chops

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drums emphasizing the West Coast Hip-Hop style with rhythmic chops and stutters to complement vocal chops and maintain dark mood.

bass_generator.brief: Create a deep, groovy bassline supporting low end with consistent energy matching arrangement dynamics without overpowering.

harmony_generator.brief: Provide harmonic pads or chords using chopped sample layers maintaining dark tonal qualities fitting the style.

melody_generator.brief: Design minimal melodic elements primarily using micro and phrase chops enhancing main motifs without cluttering arrangement.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement flow, ensuring energy transitions and varied chop techniques align with mainstream West Coast Hip-Hop aesthetic.

presetor.brief: Manage presets targeting dark, hip-hop influenced sample-based sounds particularly for vocal chops and effects layers.

songgps.brief: Control overall arrangement GPS parameters including section layout, energy curve, and event marker placement.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix settings emphasizing clarity and separation of chopped samples and vocal elements preserving dark mood and hook energy.
